// Scratch generator of forecast-curve.json, forecast-no-run.json and forecast-not-stored.json, not built
// by this repo (CHAOS-4613). From a detached acr worktree at the producer commit, add the three files
// below, then `go run ./cmd/zzforecast <this directory>`. Each stored forecast row goes through the
// real team workload field writer (distribution switch on), the real claim attach
// (attachCanonicalRows), the real summary (discloseCompletionForecast), the real selector with the
// forecast flag on, ServeVocabularyLabels, Validate and the real encoder.

// internal/contextfabric/devhealthfacts/zz_forecast_export.go

import (
	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-go/readers"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
)

// Scratch only (CHAOS-4613 ask-dev fixtures), never committed: the team
// workload fact of one stored forecast row, through the real field writer
// with the distribution switch on.
func ZZTeamWorkloadFact(row readers.CompletionForecastRow, label string) contextfabric.CanonicalFact {
	fields := map[string]contextfabric.FactValue{
		"basis":        contextfabric.StringFactValue("capacity_forecast"),
		"backlog_size": contextfabric.IntegerFactValue(row.BacklogSize),
		"computed_at":  contextfabric.StringFactValue(row.ComputedAt),
	}
	if row.WorkScopeID != "" {
		fields["work_scope_id"] = contextfabric.StringFactValue(row.WorkScopeID)
	}
	if row.HasP50Days != 0 {
		fields["forecast_p50_days"] = contextfabric.IntegerFactValue(row.P50Days)
	}
	addTeamCompletionForecastFields(fields, row.WorkScopeID, []readers.CompletionForecastRow{row}, row.ComputedAt, true)
	return contextfabric.CanonicalFact{
		Kind:           contextfabric.FactWorkload,
		Subject:        contextfabric.SubjectRef{Kind: contextfabric.SubjectTeam, CanonicalID: "team:" + row.TeamID, Label: label},
		Fields:         fields,
		EvidenceRefIDs: []string{},
		SourceState:    contextfabric.SourceAvailable,
		Source:         "capacity_forecasts",
		SourceVersion:  "test",
	}
}

// internal/contextfabric/zz_forecast_export.go
package contextfabric

import (
	"time"

	contractsv1 "github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contracts/v1"
)

// Scratch only (CHAOS-4613 ask-dev fixtures), never committed: a full result
// for a team completion question. The model's part is the claim's identity
// and scalar; the server's part runs as in Synthesize: the claim's rows and
// table from its grounding fact, then its completion forecast summary, then
// the real selector with the forecast flag on.
func ZZForecastResult(fact CanonicalFact, question string) InvestigationResult {
	p50 := fact.Fields["forecast_p50_days"]
	claim := ClaimedFact{ClaimID: "claim_workload_team", Kind: FactWorkload, Field: "forecast_p50_days", Subject: fact.Subject}
	if p50.Integer != nil {
		claim.Value = ScalarValue{Integer: p50.Integer}
	} else {
		basis := "capacity_forecast"
		claim.Field, claim.Value = "basis", ScalarValue{String: &basis}
	}
	facts := []CanonicalFact{fact}
	claims, _, _, _ := attachCanonicalRows([]ClaimedFact{claim}, facts)
	claims = discloseCompletionForecast(claims, facts)
	result := InvestigationResult{
		SchemaVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, ResultID: "result_forecast_0001", RequestID: "request_forecast_0001",
		GeneratedAt: time.Date(2026, 11, 2, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Status: InvestigationComplete,
		Question: question,
		Interpretation: InterpretedQuestion{
			Shape: ShapeSingleSubject, RequestedJudgment: "completion",
			TimeContext:      TimeContext{Axis: TemporalCurrent},
			FactRequirements: []FactRequirement{{Kind: FactWorkload}},
		},
		SubjectResolution:   SubjectResolution{Candidates: []SubjectCandidate{}, Committed: []SubjectRef{fact.Subject}},
		DirectJudgment:      "The work appears likely to finish within the forecast range.",
		CurrentState:        "The stored forecast suggests a completion range.",
		StrongestPressures:  []string{},
		Drivers:             []DriverJudgment{},
		RemainingWork:       []Finding{},
		ReadinessGaps:       []Finding{},
		Paths:               []RelationshipPath{},
		Conflicts:           []Finding{},
		Limitations:         []string{},
		EvidenceRefIDs:      []string{},
		Coverage:            Coverage{Sources: []SourceObservation{}, DegradedReasons: []string{}},
		Versions:            VersionSet{ServiceVersion: "test-v1", ContractVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, Backend: "test"},
		DeterministicAnswer: "The stored forecast gives a completion range.",
		Warnings:            []string{},
		AnswerPlan: &contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlan{
			Family: QuestionFamilySubjectInvestigation, FamilyVersion: QuestionFamilyTableVersion,
			FamilySource: contractsv1.ContextFabricQuestionFamilySourceModel, Budget: contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlanBudget{MaxItems: 400, MaxSerializedBytes: 262144, MaxMembers: 1, SynthesisHeadroom: 40, NarrowingBasis: contractsv1.ContextFabricNarrowingBasisCanonicalIDLexical},
			RenderKinds: []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKind{contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindForecast, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindTable, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindSeries},
		},
		ClaimedFacts: claims,
	}
	frame := &QuestionFrame{Goals: []InvestigationGoal{GoalAssessState}, Obligations: []AnswerObligation{ObligationCompletion}}
	result.RenderShapes, _ = selectRenderShapes(result, frame, RenderShapeOptions{CompletionForecast: true})
	result.Completeness = ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

// cmd/zzforecast/main.go
// Scratch only (CHAOS-4613 ask-dev fixtures): stored forecast rows through the
// real fact writer, claim attach, summary, selector and encoder.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-go/readers"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric/devhealthfacts"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func row(p50, p85, p95 int64, dates [3]string, values []uint16, counts []uint32) readers.CompletionForecastRow {
	r := readers.CompletionForecastRow{
		TeamID: "chaos", HasWorkScope: 1, WorkScopeID: "linear:CHAOS", ComputedAt: "2026-11-02 04:00:00.000",
		SimulationCount: 10000, BacklogSize: 40,
		HasP50Days: 1, P50Days: p50, HasP85Days: 1, P85Days: p85, HasP95Days: 1, P95Days: p95,
		P50Date: dates[0], P85Date: dates[1], P95Date: dates[2],
		CompletionDayBins: uint64(len(values)), CompletionCountBins: uint64(len(counts)),
		CompletionDaysValues: values, CompletionDaysCounts: counts,
	}
	return r
}

func main() {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("contracts/examples/v1/context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json")
	must(err)
	var example contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &example))
	cases := map[string]readers.CompletionForecastRow{
		// A real curve, with 500 runs stopped at the 365-day horizon.
		"forecast-curve.json": row(15, 21, 30, [3]string{"2026-11-17", "2026-11-23", "2026-12-02"},
			[]uint16{9, 12, 15, 21, 30, 365}, []uint32{1000, 2500, 3000, 2000, 1000, 500}),
		// Every run at the horizon: no curve, the percentiles table.
		"forecast-no-run.json": row(365, 365, 365, [3]string{"2027-11-02", "2027-11-02", "2027-11-02"},
			[]uint16{365}, []uint32{10000}),
		// No stored distribution: no curve, the percentiles table.
		"forecast-not-stored.json": row(40, 55, 70, [3]string{"2026-12-12", "2026-12-27", "2027-01-11"}, nil, nil),
	}
	for name, r := range cases {
		fact := devhealthfacts.ZZTeamWorkloadFact(r, "CHAOS")
		result := contextfabric.ZZForecastResult(fact, "When will CHAOS finish its backlog?")
		result.Versions = example.Versions
		served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(result, true, 262144)
		must(served.Validate())
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(served, "", "    ")
		must(err)
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Args[1], name), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
		kinds := []string{}
		for _, shape := range served.RenderShapes {
			kinds = append(kinds, string(shape.Kind)+"/"+string(shape.SelectedBy))
		}
		fmt.Printf("%s tier=%s shapes=%v bytes=%d\n", name, tier, kinds, len(encoded))
	}
}
